findings.evidence: `grep -n DataStructures.Matrix.PosSemidef` lists the three physics importers; `upstream/TauCeti/TauCeti/Analysis/Bochner/Gaussian/Basic.lean:8-13` shows the transitive analysis dependencies.
findings.fix: Move `posSemidef_rexp_neg_mul_sq_norm` (with the `TauCeti.Analysis.Bochner.Gaussian.Basic` import and its docstring paragraph) to its own module, e.g. `EpsilonEridani/Mathematics/DataStructures/Matrix/GaussianKernel.lean`, importing this file plus the TauCeti Gaussian module; import that from `Dipole/Amplitude.lean`. `PosSemidef.map_re` can stay here.
findings.issue: `posSemidef_rexp_neg_mul_sq_norm` (Gaussian kernel positivity on an inner-product space) is placed in a file whose topic is "Entrywise bounds for positive-semidefinite matrices" (line 16), and it forces the new `public import TauCeti.Analysis.Bochner.Gaussian.Basic` (line 11) — which itself pulls `Mathlib.Probability.Distributions.Gaussian.Multivariate`, `TauCeti.Analysis.Bochner.CharFun.PosDef`, `TauCeti.Analysis.PositiveDefinite.Function.Kernel` — onto every consumer of this module: `EpsilonEridani/Particles/Parton/PDF/Positivity.lean`, `EpsilonEridani/Particles/Nuclei/Light/SpinDensityMatrix.lean`, `EpsilonEridani/QFT/Scattering/DIS/Inclusive/Positivity.lean`.

findings.issue: The added `public import Mathlib.Analysis.RCLike.Basic` is unnecessary: the file already used `RCLike`, `RCLike.re` and `RCLike.nonneg_iff` before this PR (lines 84-91) and compiled, so RCLike is available transitively (`TauCeti.Analysis.Matrix.PosSemidef` is stated over `RCLike 𝕜`).

summary: The new QFT file is correctly placed in the existing `Dipole/` directory, but `Matrix.posSemidef_rexp_neg_mul_sq_norm` does not belong in the entrywise-bounds file: it drags TauCeti's Bochner/Gaussian theory into three unrelated physics positivity modules. One newly added import is also redundant.
